name: JCBMaximizer
author: cjitter
description: Plugin limitador/maximizador hecho con gen~, Plugin Export y JUCE
changes:
JCBMaximizer v1.0.1 improves internal stability without changing the sound
or user-facing behavior: stronger sync between the parameter engine (APVTS)
and the DSP engine (Gen), state restoration now handled via a single safe
queue, and preset loading updated to use it too.
